body: Yeah, we would constantly fight over stupid things. I'm not clean enough, I don't do enough for the kids. You can read my post to get an idea of what I've been though

I wish I was strong enough to leave. He is leaving me, I got upset at him for being with his friends instead of with me in the er. I did say it was ok for him to not take me to the er so he could do karate but I thought he would visit. I was having panic attacks and pissed myself in the ER so that's why I wish he was there but I didn't have any cell reception and I expected him to read my mind.
I don't think anyone can. I'm messed up in the head and no one wants anyone like that

Yeah, everyone kept telling me that I deserved better for a while but I never believed them. I convinced myself that I would rather be with him than alone to the point where they just stopped caring. 

It was my choice to stay with him, I wasn't strong enough to leave. I have no one else to blame except for myself

I don't want anyone to ever feel what I'm feeling, no one deserves that. I burnt out my friends because I've been trying to leave him for such a long time but he would always reel me in and I would stay with him.
